title: The evaluation request's cut notice gives advice that is wrong for entries the tracker's window did not give in full, and does not say the running evaluator's brief is fixed
outcome: The notice words its advice per group: for entries the host clipped or left out, a newer note is carried whole; for entries the tracker's window did not give in full, the new note has to fit the tracker's window (or be split); and it says that the evaluator already spawned has a fixed brief, so a new note is read only by a later request.
acceptance: The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and diff hash cited in a note.
The notice says a new note is read only by an evaluation requested after it; a test reads it.
The notice's advice for the tracker group says the note must be short enough for the tracker's window and does not say that a newer note is enough; a test reads it.
